text:
Noah Jones: FYI vendor 'SyncScale' submitted a dispute: their March invoice on GCP Marketplace charged 120 seats but their billing portal shows 60. Partner requests immediate credit and asks to pause next invoice.
Priya Singh: can you attach the invoice id + marketplace invoice pdf? which marketplace sku?
Noah Jones: invoice_id INV-GCP-2026-03-8842, sku: com.syncscale.pro.monthly, invoice pdf uploaded to s3://redwood-prod/finance/marketplace/disputes/syncscale/INV-GCP-2026-03-8842.pdf
GCP-Partner-Bot: Notification from GCP: Order 2026-03-22-997 had quantity 120 at listing, buyer_count=60 reported by reseller integration.
Ellen M.: quick check in our billing ledger: ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, sku, billed_qty, ledger_qty, marketplace_qty, charge_amount
FROM marketplace_invoices
WHERE invoice_id = 'INV-GCP-2026-03-8842';
-- returns billed_qty=120, ledger_qty=120, marketplace_qty=60, charge_amount= $12,000```
Priya Singh: ugh mismatch between marketplace_qty and billed_qty. likely duplicate seat expansion event fired twice when meter webhook retried. any webhook retries around 2026-03-22?
Victor S.: looking at event log: there were two POST /metering/v1/usage calls within 7s for order 2026-03-22-997. retry_id differs. system idempotency should've prevented double-counting but our dedupe key was missing for that vendor.
FinanceBot: Automated audit rule AP-112 flagged duplicate meter events for vendor SyncScale on 2026-03-22. Case RB-9570 created.
Noah Jones: partner says they didn't change seats. they want credit for overcharge and request stop on auto-bill until resolved.
Priya Singh: next steps: 1) pause auto-invoicing for partner (temp hold) 2) create credit memo for difference (60 seats * $100) = $6,000 3) fix dedupe key and deploy hotfix 4) notify GCP marketplace support.
Ellen M.: i can draft credit memo CM-2026-03-SYNC-01 and route to accounting for approval. tagging @acct-pay.
Victor S.: i'll open infra bug INFRA-3178: "marketplace-metering: ensure idempotency key present for meter events". will include logs and regression test.
Noah Jones: partner requested timeline. can we commit to issuing credit within 3 business days? accounting needs approval.
Priya Singh: accounting, can you approve expedited credit? we'll temporarily absorb until partner reserve is reconciled.
FinanceBot: Accounting approval queue updated: request ACK-8620 created.
Ellen M.: submitted CM-2026-03-SYNC-01 for approval. if approved, we'll post a negative invoice and issue credit memo; recommend also issuing a customer-facing note explaining root cause.
GCP-Partner-Bot: GCP support case GCP-44721 opened; GCP confirms duplicate metering events were delivered due to transient 504 on their side. They will not rebill but suggested partner-side reconciliation.
Noah Jones: OK good. Priya, please prepare partner note and place auto-bill hold. Victor, prioritize INFRA-3178 and include rollback plan.
Priya Singh: drafting partner communication now: short apology, explain we've issued credit request CM-2026-03-SYNC-01, hold on next invoice, ETA 3 business days, and offer phone sync. will paste here for review.
Ellen M.: approved to proceed with $6,000 credit once ACK-8620 completes. Finance will offset from reconciliation reserves.
Victor S.: INFRA-3178 created and linked to RB-9570 + ACK-8620. title: "marketplace: ensure idempotency_key always persisted in metering pipeline". starting PR review.
Noah Jones: thanks team. I'll update partner thread and close loop once credit posts.
Priya Singh: partner replied: appreciate quick handling; please confirm when credit posts and when billing resumes.
FinanceBot: RB-9570 updated: status 'in_progress', action_items: ["hold_auto_bill","create_credit_memo","deploy_fix"].
Noah Jones: closing here for now; will post final once resolved in RB-9570.
Priya Singh: noted — adding to monthly finance risks as 'marketplace-metering-double-bill' for March.
Ellen M.: :thumbsup:
